research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01: frozen and current official biography, ALP profile, first speech, own graduate-program post, contemporary ABC and transport-industry reporting, 2017 board-fee report, 2017 Gazette and 2019 audited financial statements reviewed. Departmental adviser is public service; ministerial and former-PM office roles separately coded.

Board evidence improves chronology beyond official aggregate: State Procurement Board appointment 8 October 2015 and October 2017 reappointment, part-time status and fee identified. Audit note 2.2 reports 6 August 2018 resignation while describing taking up a Senate seat that began July 2019. This could concern preselection, but that explanation is unproven. Seek Gazette resignation/board minutes before fixing end; do not use planned 2019 term expiry as actual service.

Business manager employer remains unresolved. Family-company employment and Transit Systems governance are established but not enough to attach the official 2012–2013 title to a precise subsidiary. Seek archived company leadership page/2012–2014 reports, public CV and employment contract description. Commercial bus contracts do not make private operator a public-sector employer.

Gillard role: policy work concerning international education is confirmed, but former-PM personal office payroll, possible nonprofit duties and transition dates require clarification. Do not label entire 2013–2019 spell service to a sitting Prime Minister, or assert direct employment by Global Partnership for Education from policy subject alone.

Hours, leave and overlaps: official year labels do not prove full-time status. Study at ANU/LSE, West African volunteering, private/public boards and adviser employment may overlap. Verify study/volunteering dates and any employment leave; no assumptions of uninterrupted work or zero earlier jobs. Public searches for full-time and role dates returned vacancies in her office or namesakes; those were not evidence of her own employment.

Source access: 2015 USC profile https://blogs.adelaide.edu.au/usc/2015/05/29/usc-old-scholars-update-marielle-smith-class-of-2004/ redirects to generic new university page; 2020 USC PDF returned 400 OK; direct APH/ParlInfo, busnews and AFR returned restricted/403 errors. Coach & Bus 2014 issue https://issuu.com/truckandbusnews/docs/cbt14_for_website_lowres was non-retryable inaccessible. Indexed and alternate primary sources used; no controls bypassed.

Follow-up leads: recovered USC archive; named researcher employer primary record; manager legal entity; historical Transit Systems appointment/cessation and pay; procurement resignation discrepancy; graduate appointment and actual hours; Gillard office contract and breaks. Last follow-up 2026-10-01; next Tom Venning.
